// CASE js_subscript_recv expect=fire
export async function a(items, step, getCache) {
	for (const item of items) {
		(await getCache())[item] = await step(item);
	}
}
// CASE js_member_recv expect=fire
export async function b(items, step, getCache) {
	for (const item of items) {
		(await getCache()).value = await step(item);
	}
}
// CASE js_sync_rhs expect=fire
export async function c(items, getCache) {
	for (const item of items) {
		(await getCache())[item] = item;
	}
}
// CASE js_destructure_recv expect=fire
export async function d(items, step, getCache) {
	for (const item of items) {
		[(await getCache())[item]] = await step(item);
	}
}
// CASE js_lazy_plus_recv expect=fire
export async function e(items, step, read, getCache) {
	let saved;
	for (const item of items) {
		saved ??= await read(item);
		(await getCache())[item] = await step(item);
	}
}
// CASE js_lazy_reset_destructure expect=fire
export async function f(items, rows, read) {
	let saved = null;
	for (const item of items) {
		[saved] = rows[item];
		if (saved == null) saved = await read(item);
	}
}
// CASE js_lazy_reset_object_destructure expect=fire
export async function g(items, rows, read) {
	let saved = null;
	for (const item of items) {
		({ saved } = rows[item]);
		if (saved == null) saved = await read(item);
	}
}
